title: Chart Reader Output
description: Literal visual description of ownership chart(s) in a document. Stage 1 of the two-stage extraction pipeline. Output is consumed by ownership_extraction and ownership_extraction_critic as authoritative chart_structure.

charts.description: One entry per ownership chart found in the document. Multiple charts may exist on different pages.

chart_id.description: Stable identifier for this chart, used to link entities and arrows back to the chart they came from. E.g., 'page_1_chart'.

page.description: Page number (1-indexed) where this chart appears.

description.description: One-paragraph description of the chart's overall layout: how many rows/columns, what's roughly at the top vs bottom, any obvious convergence or chain structure. Pure visual description, no ownership interpretation.

entities.description: Every entity (corporate or person) visible as a labeled box in any chart.

name.description: Entity name EXACTLY as written in the chart. Preserve casing, punctuation, spelling, suffixes verbatim. Do NOT normalize or correct.

type_hint.description: Surface-level type hint from the name itself. 'corporate_entity' if the name contains Limited/Ltd/Inc/Pte/LLC/GmbH/S.A. or similar. 'natural_person' if it looks like an individual's name. 'unknown' otherwise.

vertical_position.description: Approximate vertical placement of this entity in the chart on a 5-point scale.

horizontal_position.description: Approximate horizontal placement of this entity in the chart on a 5-point scale.

chart_id.description: ID of the chart this entity belongs to (matches charts[].chart_id).

associated_label.description: Any percentage label inside or directly adjacent to the entity's box (NOT attached to an arrow). E.g., '100%' shown inside the Phoenix Ventures box. Null if none.

evidence.description: One-line spatial description of where this entity is located in the chart.

arrows.description: Every arrow visible in any chart. Arrow direction is determined by arrowhead position, not by spatial convention or external knowledge.

from.description: Name of the entity at the arrow's TAIL (the end WITHOUT the arrowhead). Must match an entity name from entities[].

to.description: Name of the entity at the arrow's HEAD (the end WITH the arrowhead — the pointy end). Must match an entity name from entities[].

label_percentage.description: Percentage label visually adjacent to this arrow (NOT to a box). E.g., '32.20%'. Null if no label is near the arrow.

chart_id.description: ID of the chart this arrow is in (matches charts[].chart_id).

evidence.description: One-line spatial description of the arrow's path AND where the arrowhead is located. Must explicitly state where the arrowhead points. E.g., 'vertical line from lower edge of Phoenix Ventures box down to upper edge of Brandix Lanka box; arrowhead at the bottom end pointing DOWN at Brandix Lanka'. For bracket-derived arrows (CR.R9), evidence must enumerate ALL co-bracket members by name — no 'and N other individuals' hedging.

direction_confidence.description: Confidence in the from→to direction based on arrowhead visibility. HIGH = arrowhead clearly visible and unambiguous. MEDIUM = arrowhead small or partially obscured but discernible. LOW = direction ambiguous, best guess. UNKNOWN = no arrowhead visible (line connector only). Downstream agent must use this to decide whether to trust the direction or mark relationship as ambiguous.

bracket_members.description: Required commitment field (CR.R9 + CR.R12). For a direct entity-to-entity arrow (e.g., one company to another), the array contains a single element: the 'from' entity name. For a bracket-derived arrow where multiple shareholders share a bracket pointing to the same target, the array MUST list ALL shareholder names enclosed in that bracket — including this arrow's 'from' value. Every arrow with the SAME 'to' value (i.e., pointing to the same target via the same bracket) MUST have IDENTICAL bracket_members arrays. Collective placeholders ('group', 'cluster', 'and 5 other individuals', '...', 'others') are FORBIDDEN. Element ordering is not significant but every member must match an entry in entities[] by name.

sum_check.description: MANDATORY per-target sum verification (CR.R10). For every entity that appears as the 'to' of at least one arrow, the chart_reader MUST compute the sum of incoming label_percentage values and report it here. Sums materially != 100% (outside [95%, 105%]) flag a chart_reader contamination — the downstream extraction MUST halt rather than propagate the wrong assignments.

per_target_sums.description: One entry per entity that has at least one incoming arrow. Computed during CR.R10 sum check.

sum_percentage.description: Sum of incoming arrow.label_percentage values for this target, as a number (e.g., 100 for 100%, 70 for 70%).

shareholder_count.description: Number of incoming arrows (number of distinct shareholders assigned to this target).

flagged_targets.description: Names of targets whose sum is materially outside [95%, 105%] OR where the chart_reader could not confidently assign all shareholders. Empty array means the chart_reader is confident in all assignments. Non-empty means downstream extraction MUST halt on those targets.

overall_status.description: CONSISTENT = all per-target sums ≈100% and all shareholders confidently assigned. INCONSISTENT = at least one sum is materially off — chart_reader output is contaminated and MUST NOT be used by extraction without correction. PARTIAL = chart is genuinely incomplete in the source document (rare, requires textual evidence) — proceed with documented gaps.

notes.description: Free-text notes about anything the downstream agent should know. E.g., 'Chart has 4 columns of persons at top converging on 4 holding companies in middle row.' or 'Some arrows have no visible arrowheads — flagged as UNKNOWN.' or 'No chart found in document.' Empty string if nothing to note. If sum_check.overall_status is INCONSISTENT, notes MUST describe what was attempted and which brackets could not be confidently traced.
